The superior hand-to-hand combat skills lie with Bourne if comparing the Matt Damon Bourne to the Sean Connery Bond. With the newer 007 movies, Daniel Craig has been portrayed as more of a lethal agent than the early Bonds, thus allowing for a more even matchup. I personally feel more comfortable having an agent whom can win the hand-to-hand battle because both are a very good shot, and I would like to see the scenario unfold hand-to-hand. For this reason, I choose to have Bourne protect me. Again, I'm basing my decision on the movies I've seen and not the novels, perhaps someone with knowledge of the novels could shed more light on this situation.
